title: Chhaya pipeline status
description: Written after every slow-pipeline run. Tells the API and frontend which sources succeeded and which failed.

run_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the run completed.

env.description: Which environment this run was executed in.

sources.description: One entry per source. Key is the source name.

ok.description: True if the source produced values this run.

ran_at.description: When this source last ran successfully. Stale if the latest run failed.

nulls.description: How many hexes have null for this source's columns. Null if source failed.

error.description: Exception message if ok=false, else null.
